name: automate-me
purpose: Draft or revise a personal mode from scoped evidence and user preferences.
triggers: turn/capture my preferences or working style into a skill
wanting agents to follow how the user works
inputs: Existing personal mode and last-edit boundary
User answers and baseline acceptance evidence
outputs: Reviewable personal-mode draft and feedback revisions
ordinaryExample: After baseline acceptance, update an existing jay-mode from newer workspace history, retain uncontradicted preferences and show the draft before an authorized local edit.
capabilityLimits: Personal drafting and edits wait for all reviewed baseline dispositions and per-host supported-behavior evidence or explicit blocks.
create-skill and structured questions require observed exposed companions or a declared reduced fallback.
Sequential mining does not prove independent workers. Missing scoped history limits evidence.
Scheduling and remote creation are outside the flow. Commit, push and PR each need separate authorization.
Both hosts remain not-run. Pending authoring playbook requires Task 24 closure.
